ENGin: Rebuilding Ukraine Through 1-on-1 Connections

How ENGin creates one-to-one English-language connections for Ukrainians—and how volunteers can become involved.

  • By Paul Shannon
  • Original publication Medium
  • Date January 2, 2023
  • Reading time 2 min
View original on Medium ↗

About this work

This early service-focused article explains ENGin’s one-to-one English-language connection model and gives prospective volunteers a clear path into the program. The subject required care because the article was describing support for Ukrainians during an ongoing national crisis, not using that crisis as promotional scenery.

Organization-to-reader translation

Paul turned program information into a concise explanation of what participants do, why conversation matters, and how a volunteer can become involved. The article keeps the focus on the relationship model rather than treating language practice as a generic tutoring transaction.

Relevant experience

The piece connects with Paul’s own volunteer work with ENGin and his later educational writing. That proximity helped him describe the commitment and human purpose of the program in practical terms.

Paul’s role

Paul researched and wrote the article independently, drawing on direct volunteer experience with ENGin.

Publication note
